title: acre-gui is a viewer that neovim drives through a plugin
body:
Jack edits in neovim, so acre-gui drops its editor and becomes a viewer. `acre-gui --stdio` renders the text an editor sends as JSON lines on stdin and answers on stdout (`crates/acre-gui/src/link.rs`). A plugin in `editors/nvim/` starts it with `:AcreView`, sends the buffer as you type and the cursor as it moves, puts the viewer's errors in `vim.diagnostic`, and moves the cursor to a node clicked in the render. `acre fmt -` formats stdin for `formatprg`.

## Open

- Inside decade, the viewer window opens in another workspace, because decade cannot tell which workspace a window from neovim's child belongs to. That is decade-1919e9.
